Same hole positions as 102 for R, P, T; M12 x 1 hole for the start sensor at (70, 233);
3 x M5 x 15 in the bottom edge.
M8 x 12 DEEP BOTH ENDS; ends square 0.05 (sets the plate spacing)
30 wide; 2 x Ø5.5 in the foot at 8 / 20 from the toe; S x -54.6, J x -77.5 (face)
1. Base: laser cut, deburr; tap C (M5) and D (M6); counterbore B from below so the base sits flat on the bench.
2. Side plates: laser cut 0.3 under, then bore the R, H, U, P holes together on a mill from one datum (y 0 = roller mid, z 0 = base underside):
3. Both side plates must give parallel roller axes: 0.05 over 320 (ITP T3); the tie rod and the pivot shaft set the 310 spacing.
